name: FillFormat
description: Represents fill formatting for a shape. A shape can have a solid, gradient, texture, pattern, picture, or semi-transparent fill.
remarks: Use the Fill property to return a FillFormat object. The following example adds a rectangle to the active document and then sets the gradient and color for the rectangle's fill. Many of the properties of the FillFormat object are read-only. To set one of these properties, you have to apply the corresponding method.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified FillFormat object.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the background color for the fill Read/write.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the foreground color for the fill. Read/write.

properties.name: GradientColorType
properties.description: Returns the gradient color type for the specified fill. Read-only MsoGradientColorType.

properties.name: GradientDegree
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates how dark or light a one-color gradient fill is. Read-only Single.

properties.name: GradientStyle
properties.description: Returns the gradient style for the specified fill. Read-only MsoGradientStyle.

properties.name: GradientVariant
properties.description: Returns the gradient variant for the specified fill as an integer value from 1 to 4 for most gradient fills. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.description: Returns or sets a MsoPatternType constant that represents the pattern applied to the specified fill or line. Read-only.

properties.name: PresetGradientType
properties.description: Returns the preset gradient type for the specified fill. Read-only MsoPresetGradientType.

properties.name: PresetTexture
properties.description: Returns the preset texture for the specified fill. Read-only MsoPresetTexture.

properties.name: TextureName
properties.description: Returns the name of the custom texture file for the specified fill. Read-only String.

properties.name: TextureType
properties.description: Returns the texture type for the specified fill. Read-only MsoTextureType.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of the specified fillfor a shape as a value between 0.0 (opaque) and 1.0 (clear). Read/write Single.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the shape fill format type. Read-only MsoFillType.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: True if the specified object, or the formatting applied to it, is visible. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: GradientStops
properties.description: Returns the GradientStops collection associated with the specified fill format. Read-only.

properties.name: TextureOffsetX
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that specifies the horizontal offset of the texture from the origin in points. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureOffsetY
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that specifies the vertical offset of the texture from the origin in points. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment (the origin of the coordinate grid) for the tiling of the texture fill. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureHorizontalScale
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that specifies the horizontal scaling factor for the texture fill. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureVerticalScale
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that specifies the vertical scaling factor for the texture fill. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureTile
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the texture fill is tiled or centered. Read/write.

properties.name: RotateWithObject
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the fill rotates with the specified shape. Read/write.

properties.name: PictureEffects
properties.description: Returns a PictureEffects object that can be used to apply picture effects to the specified fill formatting. Read-only.

properties.name: GradientAngle
properties.description: Returns or sets the angle of the gradient fill for the specified fill format. Read/write.

methods.name: OneColorGradient
methods.signature: OneColorGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long, Degree As Single)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a one-color gradient.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: The gradient style. Can be any MsoGradientStyle constant except msoGradientFromTitle which applies only to Microsoft PowerPoint.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be a value from 1 to 4, corresponding to the four variants on the Gradient tab in the Fill Effects dialog box. If Style is msoGradientFromCenter, this argument can be either 1 or 2.

parameters.name: Degree
parameters.description: The gradient degree. Can be a value from 0.0 (dark) to 1.0 (light).

methods.name: Patterned
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a pattern.

parameters.name: Pattern
parameters.description: The pattern to be used for the specified fill.

methods.name: PresetGradient
methods.signature: PresetGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long, PresetGradientType As MsoPresetGradientType)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a preset gradient.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: The gradient style. Can be any MsoGradientStyle constant except msoGradientFromTitle, which applies only to Microsoft PowerPoint.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be a value from 1 to 4, corresponding to the four variants on the Gradient tab in the Fill Effects dialog box. If _Style_ is msoGradientFromCenter, this argument can be either 1 or 2.

methods.name: PresetTextured
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a preset texture.

methods.name: Solid
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a uniform color.

methods.name: TwoColorGradient
methods.signature: TwoColorGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a two-color gradient.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: The gradient style. Can be any MsoGradientStyle constant except msoGradientFromTitle which applies only to Microsoft PowerPoint.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be a value from 1 to 4, corresponding to the four variants on the Gradient tab in the Fill Effects dialog box. If _Style_ is msoGradientFromCenter, this argument can be either 1 or 2.

methods.name: UserPicture
methods.description: Fills the specified shape with one large image.

parameters.name: PictureFile
parameters.description: The name of the picture file.

methods.name: UserTextured
methods.description: Fills the specified shape with small tiles of an image.
